'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Jason Jenkins LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jason Jenkins]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jason Jenkins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
